items.name: Ring of Protection +2
items.description:
This ring offers continual magical protection in the form of a deflection bonus of +1 to +5 to AC.
ConstructionRequirements Forge Ring, shield of faith, caster must be of a level at least three times higher than the bonus of the ring; Cost 4,000 gp

items.name: Ring of the Chelish Agent
items.description: This elegant ring is crafted of dark silver and etched with the emblem of House Thrune, the ruling family of Cheliax. It is a mark of authority and protection among agents of the Chelish government. The ring is often awarded to those who have proven their loyalty and prowess in the service of the infernal nation. The wearer feels a subtle aura of safety and strength, as if shielded by an unseen force.

items.name: Booger
items.description: This prestigious vintage from the Konzdervoltz Estate—nestled in the limestone-rich hills outside Oppara—is known for its absurdly nasal pronunciation, its deeply complex notes of plums, cedar, and crushed violet, and its power to simultaneously elevate conversation and start duels. While outsiders might snicker at the name, among Taldan nobles, a bottle of Booger is a status symbol. No gala, diplomatic gathering, or high-stakes trade negotiation is considered truly respectable unless Booger is

items.name: Greenchaw
items.description: Causes user's skin to exude a slimy green glowing substance that provides light & lubrication for 1d6 minutes as Grease & Light 30'.

items.name: Phase Spider Jerky
items.description: Allows the consumer to move via Dimension door up to 60' within 24 hours of eating this food.

items.name: Bubby-Stone
items.description: The Bubby-Stone is a smooth, palm-sized gemstone that glimmers with a faint azure light. Often sought by adventurers exploring the depths of the sea or venturing into airless caverns, the stone is said to be a gift from the elemental lords of air. When held in the mouth, it makes it difficult to speak as the stone constantly emits bubbles of breathable air. With practice, the owner can use this to breathe underwater or in poisonous gas clouds for up to 10 minutes. After use, the stone must be le

items.name: Bracers Of Armor +2
items.description:
Description
These items appear to be wrist or arm guards, sometimes etched with symbols of protection or depictions of vigilant-looking animals. Bracers of armor surround the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting him an armor bonus of +1 to +8, just as though he were wearing armor. Both bracers of armor must be worn for the magic to be effective.   Alternatively, bracers of armor can be enchanted with armor special abilities. See Table 3-3: Armor Special Abilities for a

items.name: Backpack
items.description: This leather knapsack has one large pocket that closes with a buckled strap and holds about 2 cubic feet of material. Some may have one or more smaller pockets on the sides.

items.name: Cloak of Resistance +1
items.description:
This garment offers magic protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).
ConstructionRequirements Craft Wondrous Item, resistance, creator's caster level must be at least three times the cloak's bonus; Cost 500 gp

items.name: Desert Coffee
items.description:
This particularly strong coffee is popular throughout the desert empires. A morning cup is a good cure for lack of rest, but many find that it becomes a habit.
Type ingested; Addiction minor, Fortitude DC 12
8 hours; user ignores the effects of the fatigued condition.
After 8 hours; the user becomes exhausted, which is reduced to fatigued only after at least 8 hours of rest (instead of 1 hour).

items.name: Chocolate Biscuits with Fillings
items.description: The chocolate biscuits typically feature a crunchy chocolate exterior that encases a variety of jams and peanut fillings. These biscuits are commonly served with teas or juices for the young commoners.

items.name: Scroll of Scorching Ray
items.description: You blast your enemies with a searing beam of fire. You may fire one ray, plus one additional ray for every four levels beyond 3rd (to a maximum of three rays at 11th level). Each ray requires a ranged touch attack to hit and deals 4d6 points of fire damage. The rays may be fired at the same or different targets, but all rays must be aimed at targets within 30 feet of each other and fired simultaneously.

items.name: Maelstrom
items.description:
This silver amulet, crafted in the shape of a jagged lightning bolt, crackles faintly with stored electrical energy. The Stormcaller's Pendant grants its wearer a deeper connection to the primal forces of the storm, empowering those who wield lightning and thunder magic.
It enhances the potency of evocation spells cast by the wearer, as well as improving their ability to react to danger.

items.name: Booch
items.description: This vibrant green tea-based kombucha is a local specialty from the Tidewater Rock fortress in the dangerous seas of the southern Shackles, near Windward Isle. Crafted by combining island herbs with fermented tea, Booch serves to fortify sailors and sentries alike. Its tangy taste has a revitalizing quality, making it a popular drink among those who stand watch through the long nights. Folk tales suggest that this drink's unique recipe was a gift from a benevolent sea spirit keen on improving a

items.name: Stolen Winds
items.description:
"The Codex of Stolen Winds"A mystical volume bound in blue sharkskin, containing arcane knowledge of wind and weather magic. The cover depicts a ship at sea in a storm, and changes every few days in subtle ways as the waves roll and the ship barely keeps ahead of the lightning.
Effect: Allows the reader to prepare or cast control weather (once per week) if they have the ability to cast spells.Lore: Scholars believe this book was once kept aboard the flagship of a legendary elven pirate-lord, who

items.name: Torch
items.description:
Price 1 cp; Weight 1 lb.

A torch burns for 1 hour, shedding normal light in a 20-foot radius and increasing the light level by one step for an additional 20 feet beyond that area (darkness becomes dim light and dim light becomes normal light). A torch does not increase the light level in normal light or bright light. If a torch is used in combat, treat it as a one-handed improvised weapon that deals bludgeoning damage equal to that of a gauntlet of its size, plus 1 point of fire damage.

items.name: Tukkaroo Sleeping Bag
items.description:
Tukkaroo Sleeping Bag (Level 3 Wondrous Item)Price: 1,500 gp
Aura faint transmutation
Slot —
CL 3rd
Weight 7 lbs
DescriptionThe Tukkaroo Sleeping Bag is a thick, yak-like fur bedroll, crafted from naturally shed tukkar wool and lined with woven seaweed fibers from the shores of Firegrass Island. Enchanted with druidic magic, this bedroll provides unparalleled warmth, resilience, and rejuvenation to those who rest within it.

items.name: Bullseye Rum
items.description:
“It hits you right in the center, just not in a good way.”
Bullseye Rum is the drink of choice for the truly desperate, the miserly, or those who simply value quantity over quality. Its dark amber hue suggests a richness it absolutely does not deliver. The label, featuring a dartboard and the motto "Bullseye," is both an ironic jab at the drink's questionable aftereffects and a promise of its unerring ability to ruin your stomach.
